discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators (the quantum spin Hall effect)
rationale: After quantum-themed prizes in 2022 and 2025 and the 2024 machine learning prize, the committee will likely go back to condensed matter. Topological insulators are a mature, highly cited field with theory (Kane-Mele, 2005) and experiment (Molenkamp's HgTe quantum wells, 2007) that clearly fit together. The field has a long record of major awards, including the Breakthrough, Dirac and Oliver E. Buckley prizes, and it builds on the 2016 topological phases prize.
